title: Bump opum-lore pin to lore-cli v0.6.1
summary: lore-cli published v0.6.1 (manual publish, no OIDC/SLSA provenance per LCLI-482) and messaged this repo per the LCLI-469 handshake with a resolved skills/ tree SHA. Re-resolve the chain independently (tag ref -> tag object -> commit -> root tree -> skills subtree) rather than trusting the message, confirm plugin.json at the tag self-declares 0.6.1, and move the marketplace.json ref and federated-pin-baselines.json entry together.

acceptanceCriteria.text: v0.6.1 tag independently resolved via GitHub API (ref -> tag object -> commit -> root tree -> skills subtree), not taken from the peer message's numbers.
Resolved skills/ tree SHA matches the peer's claimed value and confirms byte-identity with the current v0.6.0 baseline.
plugin.json at v0.6.1 self-declares version 0.6.1 (check-federated-pins.mjs's own invariant), checked directly.
.claude-plugin/marketplace.json's opum-lore ref moved to v0.6.1 and scripts/federated-pin-baselines.json's opum-lore entry updated in the same change, per the file's own instructions.
Both federated checker scripts pass locally against the new pin before landing.

implementationNotes:
AC1-3 verification, run independently rather than taken from lore-cli's message.

Resolved via GitHub API, one hop at a time:
1. GET /repos/opum-ai/lore-cli/git/ref/tags/v0.6.1 -> object.sha 9f5f8b6fe09dfc00287a121a2cda8740e3d804fc, type "tag" (annotated).
2. GET /repos/opum-ai/lore-cli/git/tags/9f5f8b6f... -> peels to commit 20a1d24beb11f50df9f3b4ad8cb0a6ecefb92878. Matches lore-cli's claimed "tag commit" exactly.
3. GET /repos/opum-ai/lore-cli/git/commits/20a1d24... -> root tree 74bb2460c6c3a381ec6a3dc145a12dd9fdbb516d.
4. GET /repos/opum-ai/lore-cli/git/trees/74bb2460... -> skills/ entry sha 24277e9a94d6cc9b5a8c7fa12fa32c4f15eb4c0f, type "tree".

AC1: done -- full ref->tag->commit->tree->subtree chain resolved myself via gh api, not copied from the message.
AC2: skills/ tree sha 24277e9a94d6cc9b5a8c7fa12fa32c4f15eb4c0f matches lore-cli's claimed value AND matches the current v0.6.0 baseline byte-for-byte -- v0.6.1 ships identical skills/ content to v0.6.0. A git tree SHA is a hash of content, so this is proof, not inference.
AC3: fetched https://raw.githubusercontent.com/opum-ai/lore-cli/v0.6.1/.claude-plugin/plugin.json directly (same path check-federated-pins.mjs uses) -- version field reads "0.6.1", self-consistent with the tag.

Not re-verified: lore-cli's npm-publish and OIDC-provenance claims. Out of scope for this pin -- check-federated-content.mjs and check-federated-pins.mjs both work off the git tag chain, never npm, so neither claim affects what this task checks.
references: lore-cli LCLI-482 (no provenance attestation for the manual v0.6.1 publish)
lore-cli LCLI-469 (the release handshake protocol this task is fulfilling)
finalSummary: Bumped the opum-lore federated pin to lore-cli v0.6.1, following the LCLI-469 handshake but not trusting it on receipt: independently re-resolved the tag chain via the GitHub API (ref -> tag object 9f5f8b6f -> commit 20a1d24 -> root tree 74bb2460 -> skills subtree 24277e9a), which matched both lore-cli's claimed values and the existing v0.6.0 baseline exactly -- v0.6.1 changed nothing under skills/. Confirmed plugin.json at the tag self-declares 0.6.1. Moved marketplace.json's ref and federated-pin-baselines.json's entry together, recorded why in the baseline note, and ran both federated checkers plus their regression suites locally (5/5, 8/8, both live checks exit 0) before landing. Noted but out of scope: LCLI-482, the manual publish's missing OIDC/SLSA provenance, is an npm-side fact that doesn't touch the git tag chain either checker validates.
